symptom: `exec`/`check` of flows full of `create M.E (A1 = …, … A8 = …)` slowed with the number of modules in the project, not with the script: 200 creates of 8 members 14 s on a fresh app, 294 s after 30 modules × 20 entities were added; no member assignments 3 s. Cripples `mxcli test`, whose injected test flows are mostly such creates
cause: Two factors multiplied. (1) `Backend.GetDomainModel(moduleID)` called `ListUnitsWithContainer[*DomainModel]`, decoding every module's domain model, then kept the one whose container matched; inherited persistability (#1600) also listed every module. (2) The flow builder calls `GetModuleByName` + `GetDomainModel` per member assignment (`resolveMemberChange` → `resolveAttributeInEntityHierarchy`, eight more sites), unmemoised, and the same build runs again in exec's preflight
file: `modelsdk/mpr/reader_units.go` + `reader_units_v1.go` (`ListUnitsByTypeInContainer`, filters by container before reading contents), `modelsdk/mprread/generic.go` (`ListUnitsInContainer`), `mdl/backend/modelsdk/domainmodel.go` (`GetDomainModel`, lazy `persistabilityIndex`), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_derived_layout_backend.go` (`flowBuildBackend`, wired in `cmd_microflows_build.go` and `cmd_alter_flow.go`)
insight: Fixing the backend alone was not enough and the counter showed it: with GetDomainModel narrowed, 160 member assignments still cost 4001 extra unit-file reads on pedapp, ~25 each, almost all module listings from `GetModuleByName`. The memo already existed (`layoutCheckBackend`, built for the describe layout rounds); a flow build is the same kind of span — the builder only reads, the flow is stored after — so wrapping its backend is safe and took it to 11. Measure with a call-free control (the same flow with the member assignments left out) and assert extra reads < assignments, not wall time. The narrowed lookup must agree with the full listing: `TestGetDomainModel_AgreesWithTheFullListing` deep-compares every module, and the cross-module generalization chain is the one path only the lazy index takes, so it gets its own test with a control (loader stubbed → reads persistent). Issue's script on pedapp + 30 modules: exec 142.6 s → 1.6 s, check 40.3 s → 1.8 s
